create_aggregate_context: create a nested metrics aggregation context using the aggregate context manager with a named scope
log_scalar_values: log a scalar metric value with an optional weight into all active aggregators
log_speed_rate: log the rate of a quantity per second using the log_speed function
measure_duration: measure the duration of an event by calling log_start_time then log_stop_time
get_smoothed_values: get all smoothed metric values aggregated under a named aggregation context
